opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search and sort by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights for a given origin, destination, trip type and dates, then sort results by price (low to high) and apply.
steps: Open jetblue.com Flights tab
Type origin in From and choose the suggestion
Type destination in To and choose the suggestion
Set trip type (Roundtrip or One-way)
Pick depart date (and return date if roundtrip) in the calendar
Click Search flights
Click Continue to flight results in the modal
Open Sort & Filter
Open the Sort dropdown and choose the price option
Click Apply

instances.values: New York -> Miami, roundtrip Mar 27 - Mar 31, sort Price by Core (also toggled Points)
New York -> Toronto, one-way Apr 29, sort Price (low to high)
New York -> Aruba, roundtrip May 1 - May 5, Use TrueBlue points, sort Price (low to high)

opportunities.name: Budget careers openings filtered search
opportunities.description: On Budget/Avis careers, open Openings and filter by country, team and time type, then run the search.
steps: Click Careers in the Budget footer
Click Openings
Open the Country filter and select the country
Open the Team filter and select the team
Open the Time Type filter and select the type
Click Search by job title or keyword
Optionally open a job and click Apply Now

instances.values: USA, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate and clicked Apply Now
USA, Finance, Full time; search only

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: On United's Car tab, enter a pickup location, dates and times, then click Find cars.
steps: Open united.com and click the CAR tab
Type pickup location and select the suggestion
Click Pickup date and choose pickup and drop-off dates
Set pickup and drop-off times if needed
Toggle Book with miles if needed
Click Find cars

steps: Type the product keyword in the search box and submit

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, open Find a Park, search by activity or topic, choose filter values, and search.
steps: Click FIND A PARK
Click Search by Activity or Topic
Open the Activity or Topic dropdown
Tick the desired option(s)
Click Search
